title: Field reconnaissance and adjacent supplier gap dossier
creator: Aisha Kumar
summary: Synthesize on-the-ground signals across customers, partners, and public model releases to produce a gap dossier that surfaces adjacent supplier risks, quantization & hardware mismatches, and short-term procurement triggers for Redwood Dedicated and Private offerings.
background: Enterprise customers are increasingly asking for vendor-grade guarantees around quantization compatibility, regional availability (APAC), and certifiable performance on constrained GPU families. This ticket runs a focused field reconnaissance sprint to convert anecdotal signals into prioritized, actionable gaps that PM, Eng, and Sales can use to trigger procurement, compatibility work, or go/no-go product controls.
scope: Conduct 6 customer interviews (platform & infra leads) to capture procurement pain points and fallback tolerances
Benchmark 7 emerging open models across representative workloads for latency, quantization stability, and memory overhead (3 sequence lengths)
Map supplier region availability and documented deployment artifacts (owners, vetted image formats, license caveats)
Identify 3 adjacent suppliers (model distributions, toolkits, or quantization vendors) and document integration effort estimates
Produce an executive gap dossier with prioritized remediation options and procurement triggers
deliverables: Field Recon Dossier (confluence) - executive summary + 8-page findings
Workbook: model benchmark CSV with per-run params and perf/cost columns
Risk playbook: top-5 procurement triggers and recommended immediate mitigations
Roadmap recommendations for Dedicated and Private product lanes
success_criteria: Dossier reviewed and accepted by Eng lead and Sales ops (sign-off recorded on Confluence)
At least three procurement triggers identified with cost-per-incident estimates
Benchmarks reproduceable by infra team (noted scripts and container images)
risks: Benchmarks may not generalize — we mitigate by including three sequence lengths and two batch regimes
Customer interviews could skew toward early-adopter enterprises — we will weight by ARR and deployment type
Supplier docs sometimes out-of-date; validation step includes a quick deployment smoke test
acceptance_criteria: Confluence dossier created at /spaces/PM/pages/field-recon-PM-987654 and linked from ticket
Benchmark CSV, run scripts, and container references committed to github.com/redwood-inference/benchmarks (PR merged)
Stakeholder sign-off comment from Eng lead and Sales ops in ticket thread
